usedFor: Fliz produces videos, and HubSpot receives the outcome on deals, contacts and companies through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Video Completed” in Fliz, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished video can set deal properties such as the stage, so sales knows the asset is ready.

watchOut: “Video Completed” in Fliz is polling, so the deal updates after a scheduled check.
